test_title: PYST 4: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 10 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: There are 7 people sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre - A, B, C, D, E, F, and G. A is sitting to the immediate right of C and immediate left of D. G is sitting to the immediate left of C and immediate right of F. E is sitting to the immediate left of F and immediate right of B. B is sitting second right of A. Who is the immediate neighbour of A and B?
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

**Given: **There are 7 people sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre - A, B, C, D, E, F, and G.

1) A is sitting to the immediate right of C and immediate left of D. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf3dbc0dde95f27a21c3459c68848a26db5616b1a4f73eb89487a8233ece3ec0.png] 

2) G is sitting to the immediate left of C and immediate right of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/441ca641b9cdfa7cebbe634781ed41fbabb2873ce3bd0ef2b7fdf85b4e602541.png] 

3) E is sitting to the immediate left of F and immediate right of B. B is sitting second right of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6347f8ae3455a7eeb19436056c8fac9a09c2e3d9f66d08772c072e771c1b97f.png] 

Clearly, D is the immediate neighbour of A and B.

Hence, the correct answer is **"D".**
